title: MOOSE printer (ComputeStressBase + RankTwoTensor + input files)
objective: Add a third code generator that emits a MOOSE `ComputeStressBase` subclass and a matching input file (`.i`) from the same Element IR. Maps to MOOSE's `RankTwoTensor` / `RankFourTensor` types.
scope: Map MVP tensor types to MOOSE `RankTwoTensor` and `RankFourTensor`.
Emit a matching MOOSE input file (`.i`) wired to the new material and a simple tension test.
implementation_steps: Design the module layout analogous to mfem_printer.
Emit the material C++ subclass and the input file.
acceptance_criteria: MOOSE emission produces parseable C++ + a non-empty .i file.
Input file references the emitted material name.
risks: MOOSE's input file grammar is particular; typos produce runtime errors. Mitigation: use a templated .i file with fill-in fields rather than assembling strings ad hoc.
completion_notes: emit(bundle) returns {cpp, header} dict for MOOSE .C+.h convention; separate emit_input_file() for .i.
Class naming: MechDSLSaintVenantKirchhoff (stable model->class map). MFEM aligned to same convention in Gate B fix.

Medium M1 (handoff follow-up): SVK body uses _mechanical_strain (MOOSE's small-strain incremental) rather than Green-Lagrange E from _deformation_gradient. Linearizes correctly for small strain but docstring claim of 'Total-Lagrangian' is a label nit. Flagged for P8-3 or Plan B refinement.

Medium M2 (handoff follow-up): beyond-MVP material names (perzyna/JC/HGO/neo_hookean/lemaitre) get valid-looking class names via the mapping, but the emitted stress body is SVK-style. Recommend restricting to svk/j2_power_law or raising NotImplementedError for unsupported models in a follow-up.
Scope bullet 'Makefile.app or CMakeLists template' was not delivered; not in enforceable acceptance_criteria. Flagged for Phase 8 handoff.
